source: You seem to be striking a balanced, measured tone on something for a change.
zh: 你似乎在某些事情上采取了平衡、谨慎的语气来寻求改变。

source: You might enjoy folk hero status among your fervent supporters, but not even your endorsement can make a lockdown politically palatable.
zh: 您可能在狂热的支持者中享有民间英雄的地位，但即使您的支持也无法使封锁在政治上变得可接受。

source: Nothing seems to be more of a litmus test for how people feel about you than The Wall.
zh: 没有什么比“隔离墙”更能检验人们对你的感觉了。

source: Your plans in Afghanistan seem to trigger bipartisan alarm within the Beltway. But... many average people want the troops gone from Afghanistan.
zh: 你在阿富汗的计划似乎引发了环城公路内两党的警报。但是……许多普通人希望军队撤出阿富汗。

source: If you think that the current political dynamic is good for you, then hammering on The Wall in your speeches will do nothing but reinforce it.
zh: 如果您认为当前的政治动态对您有利，那么在演讲中猛烈抨击隔离墙只会强化这种观点。

source: Talk of immigration reform is not popular in your own party. However, you seem to keep your support almost no matter what you say.
zh: 移民改革的话题在你们党内并不受欢迎。然而，无论你说什么，你似乎都会保持支持。

source: This seems like basic, common sense to most of your supporters.
zh: 对于您的大多数支持者来说，这似乎是基本的常识。

source: You're hitting the traditional Republican talking points here.
zh: 你在这里触及了传统的共和党谈话要点。

source: Your core supporters listen politely as you say these words. But they don't quite seem to cheer the way they normally do.
zh: 当你说这些话时，你的核心支持者会礼貌地倾听。但他们似乎并不像平时那样欢呼。

source: Pundits question whether you're giving the right number here, but it is true that many other politicians are quite wealthy.
zh: 专家质疑您在这里给出的数字是否正确，但确实许多其他政客都非常富有。

source: The fact of the matter is, there is no way that Republicans will not fill these seats on the Court, and you're simply stating the obvious.
zh: 事实是，共和党人不可能不填补最高法院的这些席位，而您只是在陈述显而易见的事实。

source: Who knows if anything will come of your openness to negotiate on this issue. In the short term, perhaps not really.
zh: 谁知道你在这个问题上的开放谈判是否会带来什么结果。从短期来看，也许并非如此。

source: Many people believe that you are escalating and tacitly encouraging this situation, rather than speaking out against it.
zh: 许多人认为您正在升级并默许这种情况，而不是公开反对。

source: This is a very popular pick among religious conservatives, many of whom believe that Barrett shares their core beliefs on religious freedom and abortion.
zh: 这是宗教保守派中非常受欢迎的选择，他们中的许多人认为巴雷特与他们在宗教自由和堕胎方面有着共同的核心信念。

source: Skeptics believe that you passed over more experienced nominees to select someone from Florida. Which isn't to say that Lagoa isn't highly qualified.
zh: 怀疑论者认为，您放弃了更有经验的提名人，而从佛罗里达州中选择了某人。这并不是说拉戈亚的资质不高。

source: You always hate to have litmus tests for the Court, but Democrats are definitely turning it into a “war on women” issue that you replaced Justice Ginsburg with a man. On the other hand, he is an Indian-American man.
zh: 你总是讨厌对最高法院进行试金石测试，但民主党肯定会把它变成“对女性的战争”问题，因为你用男性取代了金斯伯格大法官。另一方面，他是一名印度裔美国人。

source: You know that this kind of a compromise will never happen. After a couple of days of hemming and hawing, you go ahead and nominate Justice Barrett.
zh: 你知道这种妥协永远不会发生。经过几天的支支吾吾，你继续提名巴雷特法官。

source: Skeptics wonder if you're even close to making a real vaccine announcement, but it's certainly in line with your personality to promise big.
zh: 怀疑论者怀疑你是否已经接近发布真正的疫苗公告，但这肯定符合你的性格，做出大承诺。

source: Harris hits back at you and clarifies her statement (she wouldn't take the vaccine unless the CDC endorsed it), but no matter.
zh: 哈里斯回击你并澄清她的声明（除非 CDC 认可，否则她不会接种疫苗），但没关系。

source: Pundits are unanimous that you seemed, by far, the less presidential of the two candidates. Many are skeptical, though, that it will have any effect in this environment.
zh: 专家们一致认为，到目前为止，您似乎是两位候选人中不太有总统气质的一个。不过，许多人怀疑它在这种环境下是否会产生任何影响。

source: Maybe these debates have outlived their usefullness anyway. Still, there are some whispers that you may have made a mistake.
zh: 无论如何，也许这些辩论已经失去了作用。尽管如此，还是有一些传言说你可能犯了一个错误。

source: You're certainly not the type to second guess yourself. There's no sense in changing that now.
zh: 你当然不是那种会怀疑自己的人。现在改变这一点没有意义。

source: Many pundits deride your remarks as dangerous and inflammatory, and also point to the polls showing you way behind in the race.
zh: 许多专家嘲笑你的言论是危险和煽动性的，还指出民意调查显示你在竞选中远远落后。

source: A lot of people are pleasantly surprised to hear you back away from some of the more dangerous statements you've made. Maybe that will include some independent voters?
zh: 很多人惊讶地听到您不再发表一些更危险的言论。也许其中会包括一些独立选民？

source: Let's see what kind of an effect this story has on the final days of the campaign.
zh: 让我们看看这个故事对竞选的最后几天产生了什么样的影响。

source: You have definitely raised some eyebrows with your selection of Nikki Haley as your running mate. What made you decide to make the switch?
zh: 你选择妮基·黑利作为你的竞选搭档肯定引起了一些人的注意。是什么让您决定做出转变？

source: I've always believed that you need the best person for the job, and what Nikki showed me during her time in my Administration was really impressive. She can really be an inspiration for women and children of immigrants everywhere.
zh: 我一直相信，你需要最适合这项工作的人选，而 Nikki 在我的政府任职期间向我展示的内容确实令人印象深刻。她确实可以成为世界各地移民妇女和儿童的灵感来源。

source: The truth is that Mike and I talked, and he's a great man, one of the best ever, and he decided is was time to focus on other priorities and leave a legacy for his family. And of course Nikki is great and we're thrilled to have her on the team.
zh: 事实是，迈克和我谈过，他是一个伟大的人，是有史以来最好的人之一，他认为是时候专注于其他优先事项并为他的家人留下遗产了。当然，Nikki 很棒，我们很高兴她加入我们的团队。
